chapters.title: Chapter 4857: A Scheme Across Time! III
paragraphs: His words caused Glossikos to open her eyes wide.

Her wooden features shifted with shock that she couldn’t quite conceal. Contributions to the Mouseion were not casual things. They were acts of tremendous significance, requiring items of genuine worth and the establishment of fate-bindings that would determine who could claim them across time.
She seemed to want to say many things.
Questions pressed against her expression. Concerns flickered in her ancient eyes!
But at this time, THE Primordial Paradox stepped up.
He put his hand on her shoulder.
She trembled.

The weight of an Absolute’s touch, even a gentle one, was not something that a Fundamental Depth being could easily bear. His authority pressed against her existence simply through contact, reminding her of the vast gulf that separated their levels of power.
He looked at her with his gaze of majesty.
"Go ahead and make the preparations for us, why don’t you?"
His voice was not unkind, but it carried finality that brooked no argument.
"When everything is ready, let us know."
His regal and imposing air made it abundantly clear that this was not something up for discussion.

His gaze and his hand seemed to make Glossikos unable to deny anything from him. She was a Polemarch, one of the highest-ranked beings in THE Agora, and yet before THE Primordial Paradox, she was nothing more than an entity receiving orders.
She only nodded like a cautious rabbit.
Then she floated deeper past the pools, heading toward the Mouseion to prepare whatever protocols were necessary for a contribution of this magnitude.
THE Primordial Paradox sighed as she departed.
The sound was heavy with exhaustion he had been concealing. With Glossikos gone, some of the imperious mask slipped, revealing the tiredness that lurked beneath.
He stretched with movements that seemed almost mortal, as if he were a tired old man.
Then he began to walk over toward the Pool of Lethe.
The same pool that Noah had entered during his future visit. The waters that could wash away the accumulated weight of existence!

THE Primordial Paradox entered the pool with the ease of someone who had done this countless times before. His obsidian form sank into the churning waters, steam rising around him as he leaned back in a position of grand relaxation. His arms spread across the pool’s edge. His obsidian crown continued to spin slowly above his head even as the rest of him submerged.
He looked like an emperor taking his leisure after a long campaign.
Noah raised his brows and followed.

When he entered the same pool in the future, he hadn’t realized that he had actually done it before. He hadn’t known that his first visit to these waters had been in the company of THE Primordial Paradox himself, eons before his birth.
The temporal loops continued to compound.
As he sank into the churning waters of the pool, feeling the familiar sensation of the Pool of Lethe working against his foundations, THE Primordial Paradox waved his hands.
WAA!
Something emerged from within his obsidian form.
A dodecahedron.

It pulsed with a terrifying air of power, its twelve pentagonal faces each burning with different aspects of Paradox that shouldn’t have been able to coexist. Unfathomable waves of authority radiated from it, pressing against Noah’s perception with weight that made his Seals tremble.
THE Primordial Paradox threw it toward Noah as if it were nothing.
As if he hadn’t just manifested a piece of his own existence and tossed it across a bathing pool!
"This is the most critical part of me."
His voice was calm despite the magnitude of what he had just done.
"The part that is not infected by that thing."
He sank deeper into the waters, steam curling around his obsidian features.
"I shall still make it appear as though I am creating other contingencies. I shall give parts of myself to my disciples. One even to Erwin."
His eyes held ancient knowing.
"He will undoubtedly find all of them and consume them to grasp my Claim. That is inevitable. That is what he has designed his methodology to accomplish."
He nodded toward the dodecahedron in Noah’s hands.
"But that, right there, can lay dormant for as long as it needs to. Until you can reclaim it in the future."
His voice grew harder.
"Erwin will effectively usurp my Claim to Paradox. But that is going to be a temporary thing."
BOOM!
The words landed with weight that made the Pool of Lethe’s waters still.
"The moment that I am back, I will need to discipline my old disciple..."
His obsidian eyes burned!
"And also address this weapon that he used. This methodology that even he should not fully understand."
The words of THE Primordial Paradox were terrifying in their implications.
He wasn’t accepting his collapse as an ending!

He was treating it as an inconvenience. A temporary setback that would be rectified once Noah retrieved what was being entrusted to him. THE Living Paradox, who had held the Claim for eons, who had reshaped Observable Existence through THE Fallout, who stood among THE Four as one of the most powerful beings in all of reality...
Was going to be disciplined by his former master.
Noah grasped the dodecahedron.

He felt its Immensity and weight pressing against his foundations. This was not just a piece of THE Primordial Paradox. This was the core of him. The essence that defined what Paradox truly meant before Erwin had corrupted it with whatever methodology he had employed.
|Artifact Analysis|
|Object classification: Existential Core Fragment|
|Designation: The Antinomia Prismatica|
|The Paradox of Self-Contained Totality|
|This dodecahedron contains the uninfected essence of THE Primordial Paradox|
|Each of its twelve faces represents a fundamental aspect of Paradox that existed before corruption|
|Face One: The Paradox of Beginning and Ending|
|Face Two: The Paradox of Self and Other|
|Face Three: The Paradox of Truth and Falsity|
|Face Four: The Paradox of Motion and Stillness|
|Face Five: The Paradox of Whole and Part|
|Face Six: The Paradox of Cause and Effect|
|Face Seven: The Paradox of Being and Becoming|
|Face Eight: The Paradox of Knowledge and Ignorance|
|Face Nine: The Paradox of Freedom and Necessity|
|Face Ten: The Paradox of Finite and Infinite|
|Face Eleven: The Paradox of Unity and Multiplicity|
|Face Twelve: The Paradox of Existence and Non-Existence|
|Together, these twelve aspects form the complete foundation of what Paradox was meant to be|
|This is THE Primordial Paradox in his truest form|
|Compressed and preserved against the infection that claimed the rest of his existence|
|Historical significance: If this object is retrieved and activated, it could theoretically restore THE Primordial Paradox...|
|THE Living Paradox would no longer be the sole holder of the Paradox Claim. How...would that work?|
It was a surreal thing to hold.
The weight of an Absolute’s core existence resting in his palms.
Noah began to wrap it in waves of Undifferentiated Fate. He added Philologies, linguistic structures that would preserve and conceal. He wove Archai of The First Tongue even!
Layer after layer of protection, even if it wasn’t needed but...he was basically branding his signature!

sentences.text: His words caused Glossikos to open her eyes wide.
Her wooden features shifted with shock that she couldn’t quite conceal.
Contributions to the Mouseion were not casual things.
They were acts of tremendous significance, requiring items of genuine worth and the establishment of fate-bindings that would determine who could claim them across time.
She seemed to want to say many things.
Questions pressed against her expression.
Concerns flickered in her ancient eyes!
But at this time, THE Primordial Paradox stepped up.
He put his hand on her shoulder.
She trembled.
The weight of an Absolute’s touch, even a gentle one, was not something that a Fundamental Depth being could easily bear.
His authority pressed against her existence simply through contact, reminding her of the vast gulf that separated their levels of power.
He looked at her with his gaze of majesty.
"Go ahead and make the preparations for us, why don’t you?"
His voice was not unkind, but it carried finality that brooked no argument.
"When everything is ready, let us know."
His regal and imposing air made it abundantly clear that this was not something up for discussion.
His gaze and his hand seemed to make Glossikos unable to deny anything from him.
She was a Polemarch, one of the highest-ranked beings in THE Agora, and yet before THE Primordial Paradox, she was nothing more than an entity receiving orders.
She only nodded like a cautious rabbit.
Then she floated deeper past the pools, heading toward the Mouseion to prepare whatever protocols were necessary for a contribution of this magnitude.
THE Primordial Paradox sighed as she departed.
The sound was heavy with exhaustion he had been concealing.
With Glossikos gone, some of the imperious mask slipped, revealing the tiredness that lurked beneath.
He stretched with movements that seemed almost mortal, as if he were a tired old man.
Then he began to walk over toward the Pool of Lethe.
The same pool that Noah had entered during his future visit.
The waters that could wash away the accumulated weight of existence!
THE Primordial Paradox entered the pool with the ease of someone who had done this countless times before.
His obsidian form sank into the churning waters, steam rising around him as he leaned back in a position of grand relaxation.
His arms spread across the pool’s edge.
His obsidian crown continued to spin slowly above his head even as the rest of him submerged.
He looked like an emperor taking his leisure after a long campaign.
Noah raised his brows and followed.
When he entered the same pool in the future, he hadn’t realized that he had actually done it before.
He hadn’t known that his first visit to these waters had been in the company of THE Primordial Paradox himself, eons before his birth.
The temporal loops continued to compound.
As he sank into the churning waters of the pool, feeling the familiar sensation of the Pool of Lethe working against his foundations, THE Primordial Paradox waved his hands.
WAA!
Something emerged from within his obsidian form.
A dodecahedron.
It pulsed with a terrifying air of power, its twelve pentagonal faces each burning with different aspects of Paradox that shouldn’t have been able to coexist.
Unfathomable waves of authority radiated from it, pressing against Noah’s perception with weight that made his Seals tremble.
THE Primordial Paradox threw it toward Noah as if it were nothing.
As if he hadn’t just manifested a piece of his own existence and tossed it across a bathing pool!
"This is the most critical part of me."
His voice was calm despite the magnitude of what he had just done.
"The part that is not infected by that thing."
He sank deeper into the waters, steam curling around his obsidian features.
"I shall still make it appear as though I am creating other contingencies.
I shall give parts of myself to my disciples.
One even to Erwin."
His eyes held ancient knowing.
"He will undoubtedly find all of them and consume them to grasp my Claim.
That is inevitable.
That is what he has designed his methodology to accomplish."
He nodded toward the dodecahedron in Noah’s hands.
"But that, right there, can lay dormant for as long as it needs to.
Until you can reclaim it in the future."
His voice grew harder.
"Erwin will effectively usurp my Claim to Paradox.
But that is going to be a temporary thing."
BOOM!
The words landed with weight that made the Pool of Lethe’s waters still.
"The moment that I am back, I will need to discipline my old disciple..."
His obsidian eyes burned!
"And also address this weapon that he used.
This methodology that even he should not fully understand."
The words of THE Primordial Paradox were terrifying in their implications.
He wasn’t accepting his collapse as an ending!
He was treating it as an inconvenience.
A temporary setback that would be rectified once Noah retrieved what was being entrusted to him.
THE Living Paradox, who had held the Claim for eons, who had reshaped Observable Existence through THE Fallout, who stood among THE Four as one of the most powerful beings in all of reality...
Was going to be disciplined by his former master.
Noah grasped the dodecahedron.
He felt its Immensity and weight pressing against his foundations.
This was not just a piece of THE Primordial Paradox.
This was the core of him.
The essence that defined what Paradox truly meant before Erwin had corrupted it with whatever methodology he had employed.

|Object classification: Existential Core Fragment|
|Designation: The Antinomia Prismatica|
|The Paradox of Self-Contained Totality|
|This dodecahedron contains the uninfected essence of THE Primordial Paradox|
|Each of its twelve faces represents a fundamental aspect of Paradox that existed before corruption|
|Face One: The Paradox of Beginning and Ending|
|Face Two: The Paradox of Self and Other|
|Face Three: The Paradox of Truth and Falsity|
|Face Four: The Paradox of Motion and Stillness|
|Face Five: The Paradox of Whole and Part|
|Face Six: The Paradox of Cause and Effect|
|Face Seven: The Paradox of Being and Becoming|
|Face Eight: The Paradox of Knowledge and Ignorance|
|Face Nine: The Paradox of Freedom and Necessity|
|Face Ten: The Paradox of Finite and Infinite|
|Face Eleven: The Paradox of Unity and Multiplicity|
|Face Twelve: The Paradox of Existence and Non-Existence|
|Together, these twelve aspects form the complete foundation of what Paradox was meant to be|
|This is THE Primordial Paradox in his truest form|
|Compressed and preserved against the infection that claimed the rest of his existence|

chapters.title: Chapter 4858: A Scheme Across Time! IV
paragraphs: As he worked, he thought about what was happening.

When he had finished his refinements in his past, Glossikos had taken his signature into THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts for the item that would be destined for him. But she had never retrieved it because moments later, he had collapsed THE Weavers, who were actually the disciples of THE Primordial Paradox.
It was only after that confrontation that he had returned.
And he had another body of his currently in THE Mouseion at this very moment, about to look for his destined item.
But it would not be anything put there by destiny or fate.
It was his choice to do what he was currently doing right now that led to it.
There would be no treasured item or ancient artifact for him to claim apart from what he put there himself, eons ago.
The fated item was fated because he had chosen to place it there.
The destiny was fulfilled because he had created the destiny.
What a glorious Weaving of Existence this was!

A closed temporal loop where the treasure he was destined to find was the treasure he himself had hidden. Where the fate that guided him was the fate he had established. Where the worthiness that allowed him access was worthiness he had defined through his own actions.

As he was thinking all of this, the figure of THE Primordial Paradox sank even more into the bubbling pool they were in. His obsidian form was nearly submerged now, only his head and crown remaining above the waters of Lethe.
He let out a sigh of contentment.
"Existence is always grand and full of wonders."
His voice was soft now, contemplative.
"I will effectively be collapsed soon. That much is certain. Erwin’s methodology is too thorough, too well-designed. Even knowing what he is doing, I cannot fully prevent it."
He paused, letting the waters work against his existence.
"But before I am collapsed, I shall continue my battle and my study of the weapon that Erwin used."
His obsidian eyes found Noah’s.
"You came here seeking answers regarding that weapon. Regarding the thing that would eventually become...what did you call it? THE Entity?"
He smiled, and there was something sad in it.
"But I can only tell you that I am the answer. When I collapse, I will know more. The very act of being consumed by his methodology will teach me things that cannot be learned any other way."
His smile deepened.
"What I already know now, I shall share with you when you retrieve that little part of me."
THE Primordial Paradox was planning to learn from his own death and to use his collapse as a research opportunity.
To study the weapon that was killing him from the inside, and then encode that knowledge into the fragment that Noah would retrieve eons later.
It was the most paradoxical response to defeat that Noah could imagine.
And it was perfectly fitting for the being who held the Claim to Paradox itself!
Noah continued wrapping the object in his hands with his Immensity.

Very quickly, theAntinomia Prismaticabecame enveloped inside a blue-gold treasure chest surrounded by waves of The First Tongue. The dodecahedron’s terrifying aura was contained within layers of linguistic authority!
The chest looked ancient despite having just been created.
It looked like something that had always existed!
Noah put aside the treasure chest containing the Antinomia Prismatica as he also enjoyed the Pool of Lethe for a second time.
The waters worked against his foundations with familiar weight.
He and THE Primordial Paradox lounged in The Thermae of Cyclic Refinement as steam curled around their forms.
In the silence, Noah asked what he was curious about from the words THE Primordial Paradox had spoken before.
"You talked a lot about how the Scales of Existence are designed with hardship."
His voice was contemplative and seeking understanding.
"How one has to have adversity if they ever wish to reach the second Scale of Existence."
He turned slightly in the churning waters to face the lounging Absolute.
"What more do you know about all of this? About the Vakochev Scales of Existence?"
THE Primordial Paradox did not even open his eyes at the question.
He replied calmly.
"If you were to literally be standing before the gateway to THE Second Scale of Existence..."
He paused, letting the words settle.

"If the Way that you follow, if the Civilization that you have built, has not weathered through waves of Immensity and hardship. If your foundation is something that you passed through haphazardly, without true adversity..."
His voice grew heavier.
"A doorway that seems right in front of you will be uncrossable."
BOOM!
The words landed with weight that made Noah’s foundations tremble.
"I know this because when you get close, you sense it. You understand it."
When you get close.
The words were terrifying and grand to hear.
THE Primordial Paradox had sensed what was required and understood why hardship was not merely recommended but fundamentally necessary!
THE Primordial Paradox continued, his eyes still closed as the waters of Lethe worked against his infected existence.
"As for the Vakochev Scales of Existence... well, they are-"
"It’s ready."
HUUM!
The voice of Glossikos interrupted the words of THE Primordial Paradox.

The dryad had returned from the Mouseion, her wooden form appearing at the edge of the pool with the nervous energy of someone who desperately wished she hadn’t had to interrupt but had no choice. The preparations were complete!
THE Primordial Paradox opened his eyes and blinked toward her.
Noah also turned to her sharply for interrupting the conversation.

This future Absolute entity felt like she was being stared at by two predators as her wooden features paled. The weight of two beings whose Immensity far exceeded anything she had encountered pressed against her existence simply through their attention
She looked like she wanted to sink into the floor and disappear!
But THE Primordial Paradox simply nodded toward Noah.
"Go do what you must."
His voice was calm, showing no irritation at the interruption.
"This is where I stop."
His words ended there.
But Noah heard the deep voice of THE Primordial Paradox in his mind.
Words sent only for him to perceive!
’Do what you must. At this moment, you have My Everything.’
BOOM!
My Everything.
THE Primordial Paradox had given Noah the totality of his uninfected self!

The closed temporal loop ensured that no one else could claim what was meant for him. THE Entity could search across eons. THE Living Paradox could consume every contingency he discovered. It wouldn’t matter!
With such heavy words resonating in his mind, Noah rose from the Pool of Lethe.
Waters cascaded from his transformed form, his wings spreading as he stepped onto the edge of the pool. The crown of burning books above his head blazed with renewed intensity.
And a blue-gold treasure chest rose beside him.
It followed after him like a loyal companion, hovering at his side as he turned toward where Glossikos waited!

chapters.title: Chapter 4859: The Crack Of Observable Existence I
paragraphs: THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts was a unique place.

When Noah arrived, he found himself standing on a golden river that seemed to be flowing forward endlessly. The current moved beneath his feet without disturbing his balance, carrying him nowhere while simultaneously carrying him everywhere.

All around him was a stellar environment that held sparkling multicolored lights etched across the expanse as if they were stars scattered by a guiding hand. They burned with colors that shouldn’t have coexisted, crimson beside azure beside gold beside shades that had no names in any language.
Each of these supposed stars had strings they were connected to.

These strings extended outward to the edge of perception itself, gossamer threads of fate that linked artifacts to destinies, treasures to those worthy of claiming them. The entire Mouseion was a web of predetermined connections, a place where what was meant to be found would be found by those meant to find it.
Behind him, the figure of Glossikos looked at him with an inquisitive gaze.
"All of us study and revere The First Tongue."
Her voice was musical.
"It is rare to find someone like you who calls themselves THE Tongue Whisperer. One who has mastered what we spend eons merely attempting to comprehend."
She gestured toward the stellar expanse around them.
"Because we revere The First Tongue, myself and a few others take care of THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts. Over time, we came to understand a few of its secrets."
Her wooden features held something like pride.

"If anyone is fated for anything in here, they release a glimmer of their Civilization. If they are fated with anything, it comes down for them. The strings part. The barriers dissolve. What is meant to be claimed descends into waiting hands."
She paused.
"We tried to contribute ourselves and found that we gained merit points whenever we added things to this place that are claimed. The method to do that is right there."
She pointed toward an area to the side of the golden river.

An elevated pedestal rose from the flowing current, its base somehow anchored despite the endless movement beneath it. Atop the pedestal was a swirling golden platform that churned with authority similar to the river itself but concentrated, focused, purposeful.
It looked like an altar.
An altar where offerings could be made to fate itself.
Hah!

Noah walked up to it as his treasure chest followed behind him, the blue-gold container hovering faithfully at his side. He came to stand before the elevated pedestal on the edge of the golden river, and the moment he stood before it, information flowed into his existence.
|Mouseion Protocol Detected|
|THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts is a place where merit can be granted depending on anything contributed|
|The merit is awarded only when what has been contributed is claimed by the one that is fated|
|If nobody fated claims it, no merit will be awarded|
|The contribution will remain in the Mouseion until its fated recipient arrives|
|This could be moments. This could be eons. Time is irrelevant to fate|
|Place what you wish to contribute on the pedestal, and it shall be included in the vaults of THE Mouseion|
Noah’s eyes shone sharply at this.
He didn’t waste too much time.

He proceeded to wave his hands, and the treasure chest behind him came forward at his command. It floated over the golden river, past his position, and landed on the golden platform with weight that made the pedestal tremble.
The Antinomia Prismatica.
The uninfected core of THE Primordial Paradox.
Hidden inside layers of Undifferentiated Fate and Philologies and Archai of The First Tongue.
Waiting to be claimed by the one fated to receive it.
Waiting to be claimed by Noah himself, eons from now!
Everything shimmered in golden light.

The platform blazed with radiance that painted the stellar environment in shades of pure authority. The strings that connected the countless stars above trembled as if acknowledging the arrival of something significant. Something that would change the nature of fate itself within this space.
A golden string fell down from the endless skyscape above.

It descended with purpose, with inevitability, with the weight of destiny given physical form. The string connected with the treasure chest, wrapping around it like a gentle embrace from existence itself.
Moments later, the chest got pulled up.

It rose from the pedestal, following the golden string toward the stellar expanse above. Higher and higher it climbed, becoming smaller and smaller until it was just another point of light among countless others.
Then it disappeared into oblivion.
Gone!
Hidden among the infinite artifacts of THE Mouseion of Fated Artifacts.
Noah didn’t feel any sense of panic as he watched it disappear.
He knew where it was going. He knew who would claim it. He knew that the fated recipient was himself, and that the fate binding it to him was a fate he had created through his own choices.
He turned around calmly.
The figure of the future Absolute, Glossikos, raised her brows. She looked at him with an expression that mixed curiosity and confusion in equal measure.
"Do you not wish to release the light of your Civilization to see if you have anything fated in here?"
Her question was reasonable.

Most beings who contributed to THE Mouseion immediately checked to see if anything was fated for them in return. It was common courtesy to oneself. A chance at claiming treasures that destiny had prepared.
At such words, Noah smiled.
"I will come claim what is fated for me later on."
His voice held knowing that transcended what should have been possible.
"Who knows. Perhaps at that point in time, you will also be there to witness it."
BOOM!
He said these words cryptically.

He knew his other body in the distant, distant future was with Glossikos at this very moment. That version of himself was entering THE Mouseion, preparing to claim something that he believed destiny had prepared for him.
And it had.
Just not in the way anyone would expect.
But the Glossikos here shook her head as if she was staring at a crazy person.
Noah didn’t explain.

He took a step backward, leaving the domain of THE Mouseion without even bothering to look around. The stellar environment faded. The golden river disappeared beneath his feet. The countless strings of fate retreated from his perception.
He returned to The Thermae of Cyclic Refinement!

Perhaps at that point in time, you will also be there to witness it."
BOOM!
He said these words cryptically.
He knew his other body in the distant, distant future was with Glossikos at this very moment.
That version of himself was entering THE Mouseion, preparing to claim something that he believed destiny had prepared for him.
And it had.
Just not in the way anyone would expect.
But the Glossikos here shook her head as if she was staring at a crazy person.
Noah didn’t explain.
He took a step backward, leaving the domain of THE Mouseion without even bothering to look around.
The stellar environment faded.
The golden river disappeared beneath his feet.
The countless strings of fate retreated from his perception.
He returned to The Thermae of Cyclic Refinement!

chapters.title: Chapter 4860: The Crack Of Observable Existence II
paragraphs: There, the figure of THE Primordial Paradox floated up from the Pool of Lethe.

He stretched his obsidian body as if he had enjoyed a good rest, movements that seemed almost casual despite the weight of authority that surrounded him. His obsidian crown spun with renewed vigor above his head.
He looked toward Noah with eyes that held satisfaction.
"Alrighty. With that done, we have to make our way to a fun place."
He turned toward Glossikos, who had followed Noah back from THE Mouseion with confusion still etched across her wooden features.
"Little Glossikos, thank you for the aid."
His tone was almost gentle.
"In the future, when you see Erwin, THE Living Paradox, pass through here..."
He paused, and something ancient moved behind his obsidian eyes.
"Tell him this: Existence is vast and unpredictable. Existence is vast... and full of terrors."
With such incomprehensible words, THE Primordial Paradox waved his hands.
Obsidian-gold light wrapped around him and Noah. The Thermae of Cyclic Refinement blurred. THE Villa Dei Boscoreale faded.
The two of them disappeared.
They left behind a confused and frustrated Glossikos who seemed to have many questions and no one remaining to answer them.
In THE Agora of Primordial Judgment.
Past The Middle City, the Meso Polis, where Lochagoi and their households resided in structures that spoke of earned status and accumulated merit.
In The Acropolis.
The highest district, accessible only to Polemarchs and above.

Noah arrived in the corner of such a place as obsidian-gold light faded around his form. He saw glorious temples and structures in the distance, architecture that made the lower regions of THE Agora seem humble by comparison. This was where the true powers of this Nexus resided. Where decisions that shaped fate itself were made.
But the area THE Primordial Paradox had taken him was shrouded in shadows.

Massive stone pillars rose around them as if they were spears thrust into the ground to keep reality still. They formed a loose circle around a specific point, ancient monuments that radiated authority designed to contain rather than support.
Here, Noah actually sensed four auras.
Four Polemarchs standing before something.
A tiny crack in space.

It looked like barely a sliver. A hairline fracture in the fabric of reality that someone less observant might even miss. It was so small, so seemingly insignificant, that it could have been mistaken for a trick of the light.
And yet four Polemarchs surrounded it with expressions that spoke of dedicated guardianship.
Noah recognized three of them.

Paradoxos stood to one side, his form radiating the essence of contradiction that would eventually elevate him to Absolute status. Khaotikos stood opposite, his shifting presence barely contained within a humanoid shape. Ontikos stood between them, his bearing speaking of Existence itself given awareness.
These three, alongside Glossikos, would be the Four Strategoi in the future.
The four Absolutes who would oversee THE Agora of Primordial Judgment in Noah’s era.
And now, three of them were protecting this place at the rank of Polemarch.

The fourth guardian was an entity Noah hadn’t seen before. A scholarly old man whose form seemed composed of accumulated knowledge given flesh. His eyes held the weight of questions asked across eons, and his presence radiated an authority different from the others.
All four of them had frowning looks when they stared at the arrivals.
Beside Noah, THE Primordial Paradox was calm.
He began to walk forward, his obsidian form moving with the casual authority of someone who had every right to be here.
"THE Agora of Primordial Judgment is a small Nexus Primordial Realm inside Ginnungagap."
His voice carried to Noah alone, pitched for private conversation despite the guardians watching their approach.
"Here, one of the Cracks of Observable Existence exists."
He gestured toward the tiny fracture in space.
"Through it lies the place where the enemy you came here for may have originated. The place where THE First Cause may have, or should have, bloomed from."
His voice grew heavier.
"Where THE Spark that initiated differentiation bloomed. Where the question of the oldest paradox of Existence was first asked."
BOOM!
The words crashed against Noah’s consciousness with weight!
THE First Cause.
THE Spark of Differentiation.
The Oldest Paradox of Existence.
He was standing before a crack that led to the origin of everything. To the moment before Observable Existence became observable!
It was right there.
Behind a crack so small most beings would never notice it existed!

The words that THE Primordial Paradox had spoken were unfathomably grand, each one pressing against Noah’s understanding of reality itself. He had many questions, so many questions that they threatened to overflow!
He would have preferred if this was the time when ancient beings like THE Primordial Paradox became particularly talkative and went on minute-long tangents about what they meant regarding everything.
Take as long as you needed to explain what THE First Cause was, big guy.
Stand still and give as lengthy a monologue as you wanted about THE Spark and everything else.
But alas...
THE Primordial Paradox chose to shut up.

His obsidian form moved forward with measured grace, approaching the Crack and subsequently the ones protecting it. The four Polemarchs who stood guard shifted their attention from the tiny fracture in space to the beings approaching them.

Paradoxos looked shocked and reverent, the entity whose very existence radiated contradiction immediately recognizing THE Primordial Paradox. His response was instinctive as he bowed toward THE Primordial Paradox with the deference of someone standing before the source of everything their Civilization represented.
But Ontikos and Khaotikos frowned with expressions that held something other than reverence, something that looked almost like disapproval.
Khaotikos was the one to speak.
"Sir Paradox."
His voice shifted with every syllable, never quite settling on a single tone.
"The agreement was made for us to never unnecessarily enter unless we absolutely need to. The dangers of that place and what could emerge from it..."
He paused, his form rippling with barely contained turbulence.
"We decided that it was not worth the risk to all of Observable Existence."
Khaotikos had only just begun to speak when THE Primordial Paradox raised his hand calmly.
"I do not answer to you all. Move aside."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4861: THE Prima Indiferrentia I
paragraphs: His words were measured and precise and utterly without heat or emotion, filled with an undeniable Immensity that pressed against the four guardians with weight!
This wasn’t a request or even a command, but simply a statement of fact regarding what would happen next.
The four entities before them had their gazes flicker and change, calculation giving way to resentment before settling into acceptance and finally resignation.
They moved aside an instant later.
Noah watched this exchange with eyes that took in every subtle shift in expression and posture.

He remembered how Glossikos and the other Strategoi felt about THE Four in the future. They’d visibly shown their distaste, and Glossikos had said that THE Four did whatever they wanted and then left the rest of them, the rest of Existence, to pick up the pieces.
One example was THE Creature and his Belly of Existence, where he’d literally imprisoned every single THE classification entity from THE Infinite Unfurling.
Another example was THE Living Paradox and THE Loom and THE Fallout.
An apocalypse that had reshaped Observable Existence and destroyed realms beyond counting, all in pursuit of whatever goals THE Living Paradox had deemed important enough to justify such devastation.

It seemed like there were other examples throughout Existence where those who had made the Claims continued to do whatever they wished, and others who were knowledgeable truly didn’t like this arrangement.
And now, with the information that he had, Noah could also add another action of THE Four that was done, and now all of Observable Existence was being forced to deal with the consequences.

THE Primordial Paradox had just stated that THE Entity might have its origins in this place, so Erwin, THE Living Paradox, should have entered at some point and emerged with something relating to THE Entity. A methodology or a weapon or something that he’d used to consume his own master.
And now, in the future, all of Observable Existence was about to pay for it.
THE Four sucked!
Of course, himself not included.
Although he might be biased in thinking this.

Noah smiled as he wondered about his own actions and how all of Observable Existence was or would be affected due to them. His most recent significant action was expanding The First Tongue across Observable Existence and setting Existential Tariffs for those utilizing The First Tongue as they drew upon its authority.

Which reminded him that in the future, he needed to increase the percentages of the tariffs since his power had grown much more compared to before. The rates he’d set were appropriate for his previous level of authority, but now they could be adjusted upward to better reflect his current standing.
As he thought about all of this, he smiled and nodded to the figures of the four guardians protecting the Crack of Observable Existence before he and THE Primordial Paradox passed into it.
And this time, the sensation was truly grand.

Noah felt like he was passing through The Interstices, as if he was traversing spaces between spaces or going from literally one definition to another definition entirely. As if the Existence he was just in was defined one way, and the Existence he was entering on the other side was defined in an entirely different manner.
Or perhaps not defined at all.
And...
"Oh boy..."
He couldn’t help but utter out as he felt his entire existence buzz with sensations that defied easy description.

It was as if invisible pores opened up across every aspect of his being while extremely pure concentrations of Civilizational Authority crashed in all around him with such terrifying force that any Fundamental Depth entity may have been crushed into paste.
The pressure was immense and overwhelming, the weight of potential itself pressing against his foundations with hunger that wanted to remake him.
But he had his already established an Apophasis.

He was not limited by the weight that crashed against him, and his existence was not incapable of bearing that which sought to overwhelm it, and he was not collapsible under the Immensity of what he was experiencing.

The negations held, and he barely felt a glimmer of pressure. Instead, he felt a steady flow of Immensity that was transformed into infinite potential, which flowed into his grandiose foundations like water into an ocean that had been waiting to receive it.
|Environmental Analysis - Critical Location Detected|
|You are arriving in a place filled with Civilizational Authority that is not clearly defined under differentiation or undifferentiation|
|It is paradoxical and chaotic and existential and differential in nature simultaneously|
|The authority here provides a steady influx of proto-matter as infinite potential just by being within this space|
|Your foundations are experiencing passive enhancement simply through exposure|
|More significantly: The doorway stopping your advancement past Perfect Speaker of The First Tongue is loosening|
|It is beginning to take in an influx of undefined differentiation of all four aspects of the oldest paradox|
|The First Tongue, Chaos, Paradox, and Existence are flooding into your linguistic foundations without distinction|
|You have crossed a Crack of Observable Existence|
|You have arrived in THE Prima Indifferentia|
|My analytical capabilities are somewhat compromised in this environment|
|The concepts I use to process information are differentiated concepts|
|The proto-matter is actively attempting to undifferentiate them|
The information came in waves as Noah found himself settling into a chaotic and glorious environment.
THE Prima Indifferentia.

The first sensation was one of overwhelming potential, not overwhelming in the way that danger was overwhelming or in the way that power was overwhelming, but overwhelming in the way that possibility was overwhelming. The sense that anything could happen here because nothing had yet committed to happening pressed against him from every direction!
The space appeared as an endless expanse of churning proto-matter that held every color and no color simultaneously.

Noah’s eyes tried to process what they were seeing and found themselves unable to settle on any single interpretation as the expanse before him shifted between crimson and gold and azure and black, being all of these things and none of these things.

Shapes formed and dissolved before they could be recognized, with a mountain beginning to rise in the distance as its peaks stretched toward a sky that didn’t exist, only for it to simply stop being a mountain and become something else entirely. A wave, perhaps, or a forest, or a concept that had no visual representation but his mind tried to show him anyway.

Sounds existed as possibilities rather than actualities, and he could hear music that wasn’t playing alongside voices speaking words that hadn’t been invented and the roar of storms that might occur if the proto-matter decided to become storms. Every potential sound layered over every other potential sound, creating a symphony of almost-noise that filled his perception without ever truly resolving into anything specific.

The ground beneath his feet was a concept that hadn’t fully committed to being ground, sometimes supporting his weight with solidity that allowed him to stand, and then without warning wavering as it decided it might prefer to be sky instead.

Noah found himself suspended in orientations that shifted based on which fundamental forces happened to be dominant at that particular moment, standing and floating and falling upward and being none of these things all at once.
The sky was similarly uncommitted, positioned above and below and possibly inside his own existence looking out rather than being looked at.

Everything felt colorful and yet not, and due to the immense influx of Civilizational Authority all around, storms of surging mist and authorities churned nearby with visual noise so dense and overwhelming that even Noah couldn’t perceive more than a few meters in any direction.
Beyond that threshold, the proto-matter became too thick to see through and too undefined to process!
This was the place where THE First Cause bloomed!

chapters.title: Chapter 4862: THE Prima Indifferentia II
paragraphs: THE Primordial Paradox looked around, and the proto-matter near him seemed to calm slightly, recognizing something familiar in his presence.
"Beyond the Crack of Observable Existence lies something that predates existence itself."
He reached out and let the churning substance flow through his obsidian fingers, strands of undefined potential shifting through every possible color before dripping back into the greater mass.

"It is THE Prima Indifferentia, the First Undifferentiation, the state that was before anything was sorted into categories. Before Observable and Unobservable separated, before Chaos and Order distinguished themselves, before Existence knew it existed."
He withdrew his hand, and the proto-matter clung to him reluctantly before releasing its grip.

"Proto-matter is the technical designation for this substance, and most beings who glimpse it assume it is merely chaotic refuse, the detritus of pre-existence. They are catastrophically incorrect. Proto-matter is undifferentiated Civilizational Authority, holding within itself the potential to manifest as any of the four aspects of the oldest paradox with equal probability. A single grain contains the seed of Phonemes not yet spoken, Chaos not yet unleashed, Paradoxes not yet formed, and Existence not yet actualised."
The proto-matter around them brightened as he spoke of its potential, as if pleased to be understood.

"This is why THE Prima Indifferentia is simultaneously the most valuable and most dangerous location in all of reality. When proto-matter floods into a sufficiently defined existence, that existence can direct the undifferentiated authority toward whichever aspect they wish to strengthen, and the versatility is absolute because the substance itself has made no commitments regarding what it shall become."
He began to walk through the churning expanse, his form leaving ripples that spread outward before being absorbed back into the undefined mass.

"Resources of incalculable value can be harvested here, including Spark Fragments that contain echoes of THE First Cause, Pre-Phonemic Resonance that can be refined into Phonemes, Contradiction Cores that embody paradoxes from before Paradox itself differentiated, and Pure Possibility that grants access to Chaos in its most fundamental state."
The proto-matter darkened as his tone shifted.

"However, proto-matter does not merely possess the quality of becoming but possesses equally the quality of unbecoming. It exists in a state prior to differentiation, and that state actively resists differentiation the way fire consumes fuel rather than the way water resists being shaped. When it floods into an existence, it does not merely offer the opportunity to become more but simultaneously exerts pressure to become less, to undifferentiate, to dissolve back into the formless potential from which all things emerged."
Noah’s eyes shone brightly as he listened since THE Primordial Paradox had actually gone into lengthy explanation mode.

"THE Prima Indifferentia has collapsed Absolutes because of its makeup and the things that have risen due to it. There are entities that were never differentiated in the first place, known as THE Undivided Ones, who existed before existence differentiated and refused to participate in the process. They remain undivided, undefined, and unlimited, possessing no qualities because qualities require differentiation and having no form because form requires distinction between self and environment. They are simply potential that never actualised, and they are functionally invincible against any attack that relies upon differentiated concepts."
The churning proto-matter around them seemed to grow more agitated at the mention of THE Undivided Ones, as if even this undifferentiated substance feared what lurked in its depths.
"There are many more things as well, some that I know and much more that I probably do not know since even I cannot claim comprehensive understanding regarding this place."
His obsidian crown spun with weight that spoke of ancient experience.
"This is the place for the big boys and the big players, and THE Creature seems to like this place a great deal."
A place for the big boys and the big players.

Noah only felt immensity and wonder at the thought of this place as the proto-matter continued to churn around them, storms of undefined potential pressing against his existence while simultaneously flowing into his foundations. He turned to THE Primordial Paradox with curiosity burning in his eyes.
"You said Absolutes have been collapsed in this place. Who? How?"

THE Primordial Paradox paused in his walking, his obsidian form becoming still amidst the churning chaos. The proto-matter around him seemed to calm in response, creating a pocket of relative stability where his words could be heard clearly.
"THE Absolute Sovereign of Distant Flames entered THE Prima Indifferentia approximately seven hundred years before THE Infinite Unfurling’s current iteration."
His voice held that precise diction, each word deliberately chosen.

"His Foundation was substantial. His Civilization was well-defined. His Way had been established through genuine hardship. By all conventional metrics, he possessed sufficient weight to navigate these waters."
He paused, and the proto-matter around them darkened slightly.
"He lasted forty-seven cycles of what we might loosely call time here."
The words hung in the undefined air.

"On the forty-eighth cycle, he encountered an Undifferentiation Tide whilst simultaneously being approached by one of THE Undivided Ones. The combination proved insurmountable. His existence began to fragment. His definition began to blur. His Civilization, his Way, his Foundation, all of it dissolved into the proto-matter as if it had never differentiated in the first place."
THE Primordial Paradox’s obsidian eyes held something that might have been distant memory.
"He did not die. Death requires the concept of ending, which is a differentiated concept. He became something far worse."
The proto-matter churned with agitation at whatever was being remembered.
"He became one of THE Formless Terrors."
BOOM!
The designation landed with weight that made Noah’s foundations buzz.

"Entities that were once Absolutes but who lost their definition entirely. They now drift through THE Prima Indifferentia as masses of undefined potential, attacking anything that possesses definition because definition itself has become intolerable to them. They seek to undifferentiate others because they themselves were undifferentiated."
His voice grew colder.
"It is not malice. It is something more fundamental than malice. It is the natural behaviour of undifferentiated existence encountering differentiated existence."
He turned to face Noah directly.

"THE Absolute Sovereign of Distant Flames is still in there. What remains of him, which is everything and nothing simultaneously. He cannot be reasoned with. He cannot be defeated in any conventional sense. He can only be avoided."
The proto-matter seemed to press closer, as if curious about the story being told.
"And he is not alone."
His obsidian crown spun slowly above his head.

"THE Prima Indifferentia contains at least seven known former Absolutes who suffered similar fates across the eons. Each one represents a cautionary exemplum regarding what occurs when definition erodes beyond the threshold of recovery."
Noah was listening to these words intently as his existence continued to draw in the proto-matter flowing all around them.

It was grand and dangerous at the same time, this place that pushed everything toward undifferentiation. But as he considered the warnings and the fates of those who had come before, a thought began to form in his mind.
In all of Existence, could he be considered among those closest to undifferentiation with The First Tongue?

It was the Existential language before everything specialized into different expressions. The foundation upon which all other linguistic authority had been built. And he didn’t just hold The First Tongue, he held the Archai of Undifferentiated Tongue and the Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate.
He already had many aspects of his existence that touched upon undifferentiation in ways that others couldn’t claim.
Perhaps this place wasn’t as dangerous to him as it would be to-
BZZT!
At this time, the chaotic seas of proto-matter swirling around them in this region paused.

The churning stopped. The undefined potential that had been flowing in lazy currents went still. And then, as if responding to something Noah hadn’t consciously done, the proto-matter raged and flooded into his body with force that transcended anything he had experienced since arriving.

THE Primordial Paradox raised his brows and turned to him in surprise, seeing Noah had frozen in place with proto-matter streaming into his existence from every direction. His obsidian features shifted with concern that looked unfamiliar on such an ancient face.
"Youngest?"

Yet Noah continued staring ahead as if he was frozen, his eyes wide and unseeing as something profound occurred within his foundations. The proto-matter around him had begun to spiral, forming a vortex with his existence at the center, drawing in undefined potential at rates that should not have been possible.
THE Primordial Paradox frowned and instantly moved toward Noah, his obsidian form cutting through the churning proto-matter with authority that demanded compliance.
But at that time...
BOOM!
As if everything around Noah had become a tinderbox waiting for a spark, everything exploded.
Everything.

Proto-matter congealed and detonated into a terrifying storm that held the weight of multiple Embodiments, undefined potential transforming into raw force that expanded outward in all directions. THE Primordial Paradox moved instantly, exerting terrifying power as he forced everything to paradoxically calm, imposing definitions of stillness and stability onto substance that rejected such concepts.
The explosion should have continued. It should have expanded across this region of THE Prima Indifferentia and caused devastation that would have echoed for eons.
But THE Primordial Paradox was one of THE Four, and his authority over Paradox was absolute.
The proto-matter settled.
The storms calmed.
And when the chaos cleared...
"...Bollocks."
THE Primordial Paradox cursed.
The figure of Noah... was nowhere to be seen.

THE Primordial Paradox stood alone in a region of THE Prima Indifferentia that now bore the scars of whatever had just occurred, undefined potential slowly reforming around him as it filled the void left by the explosion. His obsidian eyes scanned the churning expanse, searching for any trace of the being he had brought here.
Nothing.
He had been left alone moments after bringing The First Tongue into THE Prima Indifferentia!

"Beyond the Crack of Observable Existence lies something that predates existence itself."
He reached out and let the churning substance flow through his obsidian fingers, strands of undefined potential shifting through every possible color before dripping back into the greater mass.
"It is THE Prima Indifferentia, the First Undifferentiation, the state that was before anything was sorted into categories.
Before Observable and Unobservable separated, before Chaos and Order distinguished themselves, before Existence knew it existed."
He withdrew his hand, and the proto-matter clung to him reluctantly before releasing its grip.
"Proto-matter is the technical designation for this substance, and most beings who glimpse it assume it is merely chaotic refuse, the detritus of pre-existence.
They are catastrophically incorrect.
Proto-matter is undifferentiated Civilizational Authority, holding within itself the potential to manifest as any of the four aspects of the oldest paradox with equal probability.
A single grain contains the seed of Phonemes not yet spoken, Chaos not yet unleashed, Paradoxes not yet formed, and Existence not yet actualised."
The proto-matter around them brightened as he spoke of its potential, as if pleased to be understood.
"This is why THE Prima Indifferentia is simultaneously the most valuable and most dangerous location in all of reality.

When proto-matter floods into a sufficiently defined existence, that existence can direct the undifferentiated authority toward whichever aspect they wish to strengthen, and the versatility is absolute because the substance itself has made no commitments regarding what it shall become."
He began to walk through the churning expanse, his form leaving ripples that spread outward before being absorbed back into the undefined mass.

"Resources of incalculable value can be harvested here, including Spark Fragments that contain echoes of THE First Cause, Pre-Phonemic Resonance that can be refined into Phonemes, Contradiction Cores that embody paradoxes from before Paradox itself differentiated, and Pure Possibility that grants access to Chaos in its most fundamental state."
The proto-matter darkened as his tone shifted.
"However, proto-matter does not merely possess the quality of becoming but possesses equally the quality of unbecoming.
It exists in a state prior to differentiation, and that state actively resists differentiation the way fire consumes fuel rather than the way water resists being shaped.

When it floods into an existence, it does not merely offer the opportunity to become more but simultaneously exerts pressure to become less, to undifferentiate, to dissolve back into the formless potential from which all things emerged."
Noah’s eyes shone brightly as he listened since THE Primordial Paradox had actually gone into lengthy explanation mode.
"THE Prima Indifferentia has collapsed Absolutes because of its makeup and the things that have risen due to it.

They are simply potential that never actualised, and they are functionally invincible against any attack that relies upon differentiated concepts."
The churning proto-matter around them seemed to grow more agitated at the mention of THE Undivided Ones, as if even this undifferentiated substance feared what lurked in its depths.
"There are many more things as well, some that I know and much more that I probably do not know since even I cannot claim comprehensive understanding regarding this place."
His obsidian crown spun with weight that spoke of ancient experience.
"This is the place for the big boys and the big players, and THE Creature seems to like this place a great deal."
A place for the big boys and the big players.

Who?
How?"

His voice held that precise diction, each word deliberately chosen.
"His Foundation was substantial.
His Civilization was well-defined.
His Way had been established through genuine hardship.
By all conventional metrics, he possessed sufficient weight to navigate these waters."
He paused, and the proto-matter around them darkened slightly.
"He lasted forty-seven cycles of what we might loosely call time here."
The words hung in the undefined air.

The combination proved insurmountable.
His existence began to fragment.
His definition began to blur.
His Civilization, his Way, his Foundation, all of it dissolved into the proto-matter as if it had never differentiated in the first place."
THE Primordial Paradox’s obsidian eyes held something that might have been distant memory.
"He did not die.
Death requires the concept of ending, which is a differentiated concept.
He became something far worse."
The proto-matter churned with agitation at whatever was being remembered.
"He became one of THE Formless Terrors."
BOOM!
The designation landed with weight that made Noah’s foundations buzz.

chapters.title: Chapter 4863: THE Prima Indifferentia III
paragraphs: Across THE Prima Indifferentia, in regions that had no fixed location because location was a differentiated concept, storms of proto-matter raged with intensity that drew the attention of things that should not have been capable of attention.

Noah’s body was carried through these erupting storms, tossed and flung across undefined space by currents of potential that seemed to have been spurred into activity everywhere he passed. The proto-matter wasn’t just flowing into him anymore, it was hunting him, chasing him, drawn to something in his existence that it desperately wanted to consume or transform or undifferentiate.
And it did so with fervor.

His existence was drawing in an immense amount of it, more than should have been possible, more than any Fundamental Depth entity should have been able to absorb without dissolving entirely. He felt like his entire mind was buzzing with static that erased thoughts before they could fully form, as if he was being undefined and undifferentiated with every passing moment.
His sense of self blurred at the edges. His memories became less certain. His name felt like something he had heard once but couldn’t quite recall.
But at his most undifferentiated, at the moment when it seemed like he would become just another cautionary tale of an entity who had ventured too deep and lost themselves to the proto-matter...
HUUM!
A blue light shone in the depths of his existence.

A Grimoire fluttered inside his head, pages turning with purpose that transcended the chaos surrounding it. An Organ of Civilization pulsed alongside it, beating with rhythm that refused to be undefined.
And something else awakened.
Something that had always been there but had never been tested like this.
Something infinite.
|Critical Existential Event Detected|
|In an induced state of undifferentiation, the aspect of your Infinite Mana cannot undergo any further undifferentiation and triggered a unique state of stasis|
|Infinity is already undefined by nature|
|It has no boundaries to blur|
|It has no definition to erode|
|It simply is what it is, endlessly|
|But the effort to undefine infinity has caused an unknown reaction|
|The aspect of infinity within your existence is pulsing and spreading its musings due to the proto-matter flooding your foundations|

|In an effort to undifferentiate your existence, proto-matter is carrying your aspect of Infinity and amplifying it since it cannot undergo further undifferentiation, and seeking to impose changes through it since it is the only undifferentiated thing protecting you|
|In turn, your spreading infinity is permeating across all aspects of your being|
|This aspect seeks to impose itself on all core areas of your existence|
|The Derivative Civilization of Hunger is being bathed by waves of Infinity|
|The Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate is being bathed by waves of Infinity|
|Your existence has begun to burn with multiple infinities|
|Master, I don’t fully understand what’s happening, but it appears that instead of being undifferentiated, you are becoming more infinite|
|The proto-matter cannot make you less defined|
|So it is making your infinity more...expansive|
Noah’s mind buzzed as he wanted to move.
He really did.
He wanted to stabilize himself, to fully grasp what was happening to his existence and why the proto-matter had reacted to him with such violence.

But storms of proto-matter carried him across THE Prima Indifferentia with force, a heavy and unfathomable change inducing alterations to his own infinity that he couldn’t control. His aspect of Infinite Mana, which had always been the foundation of everything he was, pulsed with light that painted the undefined storms in shades of blue-gold that shouldn’t have existed in a place where color hadn’t fully differentiated.

The Derivative Civilization of Hunger roared within him, its endless appetite meeting endless fuel and expanding in ways that transcended normal growth. The Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate shimmered with potential that connected to the proto-matter around it, drawing in threads of possibility that hadn’t been woven into anything yet.
His existence burned brighter with every moment that passed.
And the storms carried him deeper into THE Prima Indifferentia, toward things that had been sleeping since before differentiation occurred.
In an unknown region of THE Prima Indifferentia.

In an area surrounded by obsidian pillars of proto-matter that rose from the undefined ground like teeth in a cosmic mouth, a creature could be seen bouncing around the pillars as if it were having fun.

Its Civilization was not completely clear, existing in a unique state that held both undifferentiation and differentiation simultaneously. It was something that shouldn’t have been possible, a being that had refused to fully commit to either state and had somehow persisted in that refusal since before THE Infinite Unfurling.

The creature looked like a round obsidian furball, perhaps three meters in diameter, with a surface that shifted between solid and gaseous without ever settling on one or the other. Two twinkling obsidian eyes sat at its center, holding an innocent and playful expression that seemed almost childlike as it continued to bounce from pillar to pillar, leaving ripples in the proto-matter wherever it touched.
It had been bouncing for eons.
It would bounce for eons more.
Time had no meaning here, and this creature had long since forgotten what urgency felt like.
As it bounced toward another pillar, preparing to ricochet off into whatever direction amused it next...
HUUM!
Time, which had no meaning here, slowed anyway.

A moment later, the creature blinked as it saw the visage of a humanoid winged entity with a crown of burning pages surge past this region like a hurricane. The entity was surrounded by a storm of proto-matter so dense and violent that it painted the undefined space in shades of blue-gold that shouldn’t have existed here, and its existence blazed with something that the furball had never encountered before!
The eyes of the fur-like entity glimmered with interest, and the innocent playfulness in them shifted into something else entirely.
Hunger!
BOOM!
The transformation was instant and horrifying.

The entire body of the obsidian furball became a horror-inducing mass of flesh and fur that expanded outward in all directions, growing from three meters to three hundred to three thousand in the span of a heartbeat. A million crimson eyes bloomed across its surface, each one containing jagged jaws that opened and closed with anticipation. Tentacles that ended in more mouths erupted from its form. Wings that were also teeth spread wide. Every inch of this entity became a weapon designed for consumption.

It shot out at speeds exceeding lesser and weaker Absolutes like THE Living Elemental, crossing the distance between itself and its prey in less time than it took for light to decide whether it existed here or not.
"KAAA!"
It screeched out with fervor and excitement as if it had found a particularly good meal after eons of eating nothing but proto-matter and the occasional foolish Absolute who wandered too deep.
Its body arrived before the storm of proto-matter instantly, and then it opened.
Not like a mouth opens.
Like reality opens when it decides to stop being real!

A slit appeared in its form that led into an abyssal realm of pure undifferentiation, a stomach that had digested things that shouldn’t have been digestible, a void that had unmade beings who thought themselves eternal.
It swallowed both the proto-matter storm and the figure contained within it in a single bite.

chapters.title: Chapter 4864: THE Prima Indifferentia IV
paragraphs: Being carried across THE Prima Indifferentia without being able to move was horrible, but manageable.

Noah had been working with the situation, allowing his infinities to spread through his existence while the proto-matter storms transported him to wherever they wished. He’d been adapting, evolving, becoming something more than he had been when he first entered through the Crack!
But...
Being swept across the storm as a monstrous thing appeared and swallowed him whole...
This was not manageable.

Darkness surrounded him instantly, but it wasn’t the darkness of absence. It was the darkness of presence, the weight of something so fundamentally undefined that light itself couldn’t exist within it. He felt the walls of this stomach pressing against his existence from every direction, and he felt them beginning to work.
|Critical Alert|
|You have been devoured by THE Undivided One, Bazuman|
|THE Undivided Ones are arguably the most dangerous entities in THE Prima Indifferentia|
|They are beings that existed before existence differentiated but who refused to differentiate with it|
|They remain in their original state: undivided, undefined, and partiallyunlimited|
|They cannot be fought because fighting requires the fighter and the fought to be separate things|
|They cannot be reasoned with because reasoning requires distinct concepts to compare|
|They cannot be avoided because avoidance requires a distinction between presence and absence|
|Bazuman has consumed an unknown number of Absolutes across the eons|
|None of them escaped|
|None of them survived|
|Your current Depth is insufficient to resist digestion|
|Estimated time until complete undifferentiation: decreasing|
When it rained, it poured.

In addition to the proto-matter continuing to flood into him from the storms he’d been carried through, Noah now felt a different force pressing down all around him. The digestive pressure of THE Undivided One, Bazuman, was unbelievably heavy, exceeding even the force that he had felt from THE Hollow Echo of THE Creature in The Interstices.
In an instant, Noah saw his arms and legs beginning to unravel.

Inside the stomach of this creature, his weight and Immensity was being unmade and undifferentiated in a manner that far exceeded what the proto-matter had been doing on its own. His fingers blurred at the edges. His wings lost their definition. His crown of burning pages flickered as the Phonemes contained within them began to forget what they were supposed to mean.
But...

Noah felt the unprecedented danger and situation around him as the change that had been spurred by proto-matter still remained within his foundations. He felt all his Ways as they burned with Infinities. His Organ of Civilization burned with infinity. THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons burned with infinity. His entire existence burned with Infinity in ways that he hadn’t fully understood until this very moment.
The perilous enemy he faced could easily undifferentiate even Absolutes, and Noah’s Depth couldn’t compare to such beings.
Not even close.
But he didn’t only have his Depth.

In such a perilous moment as his arms and legs unraveled further, as his existence threatened to dissolve into the stomach of something that had never failed to digest its prey, Noah actually closed his eyes and felt the beat of his heart.
It was...
DUM DUM DUM...

It beat repetitively and infinitely, because the influx of proto-matter seeking to undifferentiate him had instead bathed his heart in infinity when it couldn’t undifferentiate what was already beyond definition.
In order to fight an enemy he couldn’t win against through conventional means, he called out lightly.
"Beat loudly."
HUUM!
His heart responded, and the infinity within it flared brighter.
"Beat tyrannically."
WAA!
His heart thundered, and the infinities spread through his existence began to pulse in rhythm with it.
"Beat... infinitely."
BOOM!
An instant later, Noah’s unraveling limbs reformed.

But they didn’t reform as flesh and blood and the normal composition of his existence. They reformed as pure blue-gold infinities given physical shape, light that had no perceivable end taking the form of arms and legs and wings that spread wide with authority that transcended Depth entirely!
He didn’t call upon his Depth.
He didn’t need to.
He released his Infinities that couldn’t be undifferentiated into the belly of a creature that had always succeeded in undifferentiating everything it had ever consumed.
From Noah’s body, a flicker of infinity bloomed.

And this flicker groaned and boomed as if it were an unfathomable beast waking up from slumber that had lasted since before time existed. It asserted itself with weight that had nothing to do with Foundation or Civilization or Way, a weight that simply was because infinity simply was.
How dare you try to undifferentiate what cannot be undifferentiated?
The question wasn’t spoken aloud, but it echoed through the stomach of Bazuman with force that made the walls of undifferentiation tremble for the first time in their existence.
With such a regal and grand resonance, the glimmer of blue-gold infinity erupted outward like a blade.
It carved through the stomach of something that had never been carved before.
It cut through undifferentiation itself, forcing the definition of infinity into a space that had rejected definition since before THE Infinite Unfurling.
And it kept cutting until it reached the outside.
In a region surrounded by pillars of proto-matter, the visage of Bazuman paused.

The massive horror that had been so eager to consume THE First Tongue went still, its million crimson eyes blinking in unison as something unprecedented occurred within its form. It had swallowed its prey. It had begun digesting. The process had always worked before.
Why wasn’t it working now?
A cut appeared on its body.
A line of blue-gold light that should not have been possible, a wound inflicted by something that had no business being able to wound THE Undivided.
And from that cut, a blue-gold light of a man shot out.
Noah’s figure emerged from the belly of the beast, his existence burning with infinities that painted the proto-matter around him in shades that THE Prima Indifferentia had never seen before!
He was still learning how to use this brilliance, still understanding what had changed within him and how to direct it, but he understood enough.
He floated before Bazuman, his blue-gold form facing the horror of a million crimson eyes and jagged jaws, and he spoke calmly.
"I... am not food."

An immense silence settled across this region of THE Prima Indifferentia alongside heavy unease that even the proto-matter seemed to feel. Bazuman’s countless eyes focused on the being before it, studying something that had escaped its stomach for the first time in its existence.
And within Noah, prompts bloomed.
|Existential Transformation Detected|
|Your Formless Depth burns with infinities|
|All aspects of your existence have become more aligned with the central weaving of your being|
|The Derivative Civilization of Hunger has been bathed in Infinity|
|The Derivative Civilization of Undifferentiated Fate has been bathed in Infinity|
|Your Way burns with Infinity|
|Your Foundation burns with Infinity|
|You have produced your first Infinite Everything|
|Not an Absolute Everything|
|An Infinite Everything|

Noah had been working with the situation, allowing his infinities to spread through his existence while the proto-matter storms transported him to wherever they wished.
He’d been adapting, evolving, becoming something more than he had been when he first entered through the Crack!
But...
Being swept across the storm as a monstrous thing appeared and swallowed him whole...
This was not manageable.
Darkness surrounded him instantly, but it wasn’t the darkness of absence.
It was the darkness of presence, the weight of something so fundamentally undefined that light itself couldn’t exist within it.
He felt the walls of this stomach pressing against his existence from every direction, and he felt them beginning to work.

|THE Undivided Ones are arguably the most dangerous entities in THE Prima Indifferentia|
|They are beings that existed before existence differentiated but who refused to differentiate with it|
|They remain in their original state: undivided, undefined, and partiallyunlimited|
|They cannot be fought because fighting requires the fighter and the fought to be separate things|
|They cannot be reasoned with because reasoning requires distinct concepts to compare|
|They cannot be avoided because avoidance requires a distinction between presence and absence|

|None of them survived|
|Your current Depth is insufficient to resist digestion|

In an instant, Noah saw his arms and legs beginning to unravel.
Inside the stomach of this creature, his weight and Immensity was being unmade and undifferentiated in a manner that far exceeded what the proto-matter had been doing on its own.
His fingers blurred at the edges.
His wings lost their definition.
His crown of burning pages flickered as the Phonemes contained within them began to forget what they were supposed to mean.
But...
Noah felt the unprecedented danger and situation around him as the change that had been spurred by proto-matter still remained within his foundations.
He felt all his Ways as they burned with Infinities.
His Organ of Civilization burned with infinity.
THE Grimoire of Infinite Lexicons burned with infinity.
His entire existence burned with Infinity in ways that he hadn’t fully understood until this very moment.
The perilous enemy he faced could easily undifferentiate even Absolutes, and Noah’s Depth couldn’t compare to such beings.
Not even close.
But he didn’t only have his Depth.

It was...
DUM DUM DUM...

It beat repetitively and infinitely, because the influx of proto-matter seeking to undifferentiate him had instead bathed his heart in infinity when it couldn’t undifferentiate what was already beyond definition.
In order to fight an enemy he couldn’t win against through conventional means, he called out lightly.
"Beat loudly."
HUUM!
His heart responded, and the infinity within it flared brighter.
"Beat tyrannically."
WAA!
His heart thundered, and the infinities spread through his existence began to pulse in rhythm with it.
"Beat... infinitely."
BOOM!

But they didn’t reform as flesh and blood and the normal composition of his existence.

He didn’t call upon his Depth.
He didn’t need to.
He released his Infinities that couldn’t be undifferentiated into the belly of a creature that had always succeeded in undifferentiating everything it had ever consumed.

And this flicker groaned and boomed as if it were an unfathomable beast waking up from slumber that had lasted since before time existed.
